audit_items.proof_trace: Normal liquidation enforces shortfall > 0 via `weighted_debts_value > collateral_weighted_value` (L978-981). ADL paths use a custom decreasing LTV threshold (`liquidation_ltv_threshold_override`) that can reach 0 over time, allowing liquidation of solvent positions, but this is intentional: ADL only activates when protocol-wide limits are breached (`ensure_limit_breached`) and a timelock has elapsed, making it an emergency deleveraging mechanism by design rather than a vulnerability.
